race.comment: REGAL HUNTER (2) has been thereabouts without winning, the latest fourth over a mile on the turf. Was runner-up this course and distance the start prior making it two minors from two tries. Goes close off the low draw. AZONTO (1) wound up strongly too score here last time when dropping back to 1350m. Leading rider stays aboard and can wind up late again. RESPITE (3) has been freshened since a close-up sixth behind Tikken here last time. Up a grade but much better draw and down in weight. Leading player. ALISENT (6) is fitter for two runs back and weighted to feature. TIZSA NICE DROP (7) is back in grade and capable of a big run.
